definitions.explanation: Devoting oneself exclusively to one type of work or business, without a side job or other occupation.

examples.japanese: {専業|せんぎょう}{主婦|しゅふ}になった。
{専業|せんぎょう}⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: He grows rice as a full-time farmer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧、⟦{本業|ほんぎょう}→本業：12887_hongyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{専業|せんぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to quit my side job and focus solely on my main business.

notes:
USAGE:
{専業|せんぎょう} is most commonly used as a modifier before a noun, especially in the compounds {専業|せんぎょう}{主婦|しゅふ} (full-time housewife) and {専業|せんぎょう}⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧ (full-time farmer). It contrasts with ⟦{兼業|けんぎょう}→兼業：08562_kengyou⟧ (side business; holding multiple jobs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専業|せんぎょう}{主婦|しゅふ} (full-time housewife)
- {専業|せんぎょう}{主夫|しゅふ} (full-time househusband)
- {専業|せんぎょう}⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧ (full-time farming household)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{兼業|けんぎょう}→兼業：08562_kengyou⟧ (side business; working in multiple occupations) is the antonym.
